levels.topic: The guide's Topic: A-J (Compulsory Part). The Elective Part has no letter in the guide; topics.ts calls its two parts EL1 and EL2.
levels.keyPoint: One entry of the guide's Key Points column that heads a block (compulsory), or one entry of the Topic column in an Elective Part table. The code is the topics.ts fine code, e.g. C.ped.
levels.point: The guide's own (i), (ii)... item inside a key point. A key point with no numerals has one implicit point (slug "whole"), or one point per top-level bullet (J.bop). Code = <key point code>#<slug>, e.g. C.ped#arc. Slugs are mine (frozen once adopted), the label is the guide's numbering.
levels.detail: A bullet inside a point, name only (informational; not a code).

meta.codeGrammarNote: Point codes use "#", which the tag grammar in src/model/topics.ts (TOPIC_CODE_PATTERN) does not allow: they are not topic codes and must never be stored in Question.tags. See the analysis, section 10.4 (where the result is stored).
meta.pageRefs: Printed page numbers, not PDF page numbers. Guide: printed = PDF page - 6 (from Chapter 1 on). Both Supplementary Documents: printed = PDF page - 1. A range is [first, last].

skillsVocabulary.recall: state / define / describe / recognise the meaning
skillsVocabulary.examples: give, identify or classify with examples
skillsVocabulary.explain: explain or analyse a relationship, reason or effect
skillsVocabulary.calculate: numerical work (the Supplement says calculate, numerically or schedule)
skillsVocabulary.diagram: a diagram, graph or schedule is expected
skillsVocabulary.data: interpret given numerical or graphical data
skillsVocabulary.evaluate: discuss, judge or make an informed (normative) judgement

meta.skillsNote: Flags are my reading of the verbs in the Supplementary Document's "Elaboration" column, kept conservative: a flag is set only where the text names the skill. They need a teacher's review.
meta.verification: Every EN name (guide + EN supplement) and 中文 name (Chinese supplement) was checked to occur verbatim, in document order, at the start of a line of the PDF text. Printed typos and wording differences between guide and supplement are listed in the analysis, section 1.3.
